operations.title: Rebuild table

fields.label: Columns
fields.help: Array of name, type, nullable, default, unique and primary_key properties.

operations.notes: Typed design transport sqlite_schema_object_design: database_target_id, baseline DDN, resource_id, fixed operation=rebuild, fields from this form. This generates desired DDN without file mutation; it is not generic operation apply. Show the complete sqlite_schema_plan SQL and dependencies; pass returned rebuilds for tables. Use sqlite_schema_review with execution_sha256 and then sqlite_schema_apply with review_id/review_digest/confirmed:true.
